Game Overview

In Santas Gift Hunt, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a festive quest in Santa's Gift Hunt, where quick thinking meets strategic movement. Navigate in straight paths to collect gifts while dodging tricky Goblins. With every decision mattering, sharpen your reflexes for a thrilling puzzle challenge wrapped in Christmas cheer.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Santas Gift Hunt is easy to pick up. Embark on a festive quest in Santa's Gift Hunt, where quick thinking meets strategic movement.
